messages:
carmen.partners: Quick update: LumenHealth is GA on the Azure Marketplace. Tile is live with a co-branded case blurb and a 30-day trial. https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/items/lumenhealth
marketplace-bot: Azure Marketplace listing for LumenHealth published by carmen.partners at 2026-03-23T09:05:22Z
diego.sales: Huge — they signed a 6-month reserved commitment + Private deployment for PHI. Can we get a customer-approved quote and logo assets for the pitch deck?
fiona.prod: They validated our endpoint failover and observed stable latency under burst traffic. Suggest we include the failover diagram and the min/max autoscale values in the case note.
ashley.marketing: I'll prepare a short customer highlight and a 60s video for the marketplace tile. @noah.support, can you drop the condensed onboarding checklist and any SSO notes?
noah.support: Yep, uploading onboarding checklist and Azure AD SAML steps in the launch drive now. Also adding the small runbook we used for cross-subscription networking.
carmen.partners: FYI finance — hybrid revenue (marketplace + reserved). @diego.sales please loop finance on revenue recognition details.
diego.sales: Doing that now. Also tagging this as a reference for the healthcare vertical playbook.
ashley.marketing: Draft headline options: "LumenHealth secures PHI inference with Redwood Private" or "LumenHealth cuts inference cost with reserved Dedicated pools"  leaning to the first for compliance emphasis.
fiona.prod: First works for enterprise audiences. We can support the cost angle in the deeper case study if they share numbers.
carmen.partners: I'll ask for permission to publish any metrics. Meanwhile please react with :white_check_mark: once assets are in the drive so I can close the launch task. Thanks team!
